programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programmes.d: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programmes.d: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programmes.d: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programmes.d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programmes.d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programmes.d: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programmes.d: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programmes.d: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programmes.d: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programmes.d: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programmes.t: Split Second
programmes.d: I en dystopisk fremtid jager en detektiv en seriemorder, der viser sig ikke at være menneskelig.

programmes.t: Texas Chainsaw
programmes.d: Gennem mange år var adskillige personer i den lille by Newt i Texas forsvundet sporløst. Befolkningen havde længe mistænkt familien Sawyer, og det lykkedes en ung pige at flygte fra Sawyer-huset efter de brutale drab på hendes fire venner.

programmes.t: Dorian Gray
programmes.d: Ben Barnes (kendt fra Narnia - Prince Caspian) spiller den unge og smukke Dorian Gray, som bliver introduceret til Londons dekadente jetset af den charmerende Henry Wotton (Colin Firth - kendt fra Mamma Mia).

programmes.t: Finders Keepers
programmes.d: Da Allyson Simons bliver separeret fra sin mand og flytter med deres 9-årige datter Claire til et stort, gammelt hus på landet, finder hun ud af, at der fem år tidligere er blevet begået et brutalt familiemord i huset.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programmes.d: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programmes.d: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programmes.d: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programmes.d: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programmes.d: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Cold Equations
programmes.d: A rescue pilot on the frontiers of space is faced with unpleasant prospects when he finds an innocent stowaway on his ship.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
programmes.d: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Street of Shadows
programmes.d: While taking a walk in a wealthy neighborhood, an unemployed man living in a shelter experiences an unusual transformation

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Something in the Walls
programmes.d: A doctor arrives at his new job in a sanitarium. He discovers the case of a woman who is terribly frightened of things that appear on her walls.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Room 2426
programmes.d: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Mind of Simon Foster
programmes.d: In an impoverished future, Simon Foster goes to a pawnshop to sell some personal items to raise money for rent. The shop owner offers to buy some of his memories. In Simon Foster's life, what could be possibly be valuable?

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Wall
programmes.d: A U.S. military experiment opens a portal to an unknown place. After sending through one team, the Army calls upon a career soldier to investigate, where he finds an idyllic planet. He has to decide whether to stay or go back to his old life.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Cat and Mouse
programmes.d: A shy woman finds that a cat is actually a cursed "Casanova." She falls for the man but finds that her Prince Charming is actually a scoundrel.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Rendezvous in a Dark Place
programmes.d: An old woman with an obsession with death attends funerals for entertainment. One night when an injured thief breaks into her home, she lets him die and waits for Death to come and collect him.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Many, Many Monkeys
programmes.d: An epidemic breaks out and many people are struck blind. Something more happens, however: People have become cold and heartless toward each other

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Love Is Blind
programmes.d: A man plotting to murder his wife's lover meets a blind singer who seems to know all about his plans.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Crazy as a Soup Sandwich
programmes.d: A man sells his soul to a demon for some racing tips. After being terrified by the demon he goes for help from the criminal boss he borrowed the track money from

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Special Service
programmes.d: A man finds that his life has been on TV for the past five years

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
programmes.d: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programmes.d: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Cavender is Coming
programmes.d: Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programmes.d: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programmes.d: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programmes.d: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.
